messages:
maria_ops: FYI scheduling a midnight maintenance window for az-sea-2 to address intermittent NIC flaps seen over the last 24h. Plan: staggered cordon + reboot of GPU hosts in 6 cohorts, warm prefix/KV cache between cohorts, and backfill from eu-west and us-central pools. Window: 2026-03-28 00:30-03:30 UTC. Posting here so teams can opt to pause heavy batches.

sanjay_infra: what's the expected capacity hit and can we avoid customer-impacting throttles? :thinking:

maria_ops: expect ~10-14% GPU capacity offline at peak per cohort (each cohort ~12 nodes). Autoscaler will slowly ramp cross-region backfill to keep latency SLOs. Risk: temporary throughput drop for high-concurrency tails. Cost impact: estimated +$3.5k if we use on-demand; reduce by shifting low-priority jobs to spot.

elaine_sre: need a canary plan. which cohort goes first? and rollback criteria?

maria_ops: canary = cohort-1 (non-prod tagged nodes, low-util tenants). Validation steps: verify NIC error rates drop to baseline <0.1% over 30m; run smoke on token-gen p99 & internal canary prompt set; confirm KV cache warm hit-rate >= 70% before proceeding. Rollback: any p99 regressions >20% or NIC err increase +0.5% => stop, un-cordon, abort next cohorts. Will post playbook in #eng-oncall.

tom_devex: can we get a short customer blurb? want to avoid long notices.

maria_ops: draft: "Planned maintenance: 2026-03-28 00:30-03:30 UTC in az-sea-2. Short rolling reboots of GPU hosts for NIC firmware stabilization. You may see brief throughput reductions for high-concurrency requests. No sustained downtime expected. Contact support if you see issues."

tom_devex: perfect, I'll push to status page and notify flagged customers.

deploy-bot: incident created: INC-20260328-azsea2-maint (scheduled) — owner: @maria_ops — start: 2026-03-28T00:30:00Z

sanjay_infra: ops checklist snippet for operators: 
```
# cordon cohort
kubectl get nodes -l cohort=azsea2-c1 -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
# drain non-critical pods, keep runtime tasks pinned
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='!critical'
# reboot
ssh root@<node> 'sudo reboot'
```

elaine_sre: add a step to disable cross-region burst autoscaler for the first cohort - avoid overshoot and unexpected cost before canary validation.

maria_ops: good call. we'll pause cross-region autoscale for 10m during canary then re-enable if green.

secops: any keys or images affected? security windows? :shield:

maria_ops: no KMS changes. We're only rebooting nodes and applying NIC microcode (non-credential). SecOps will receive rollout manifest; nothing touches secrets.

sanjay_infra: notify internal marketplace & infra-scheduler teams to hold model rollout jobs and quantization sweeps between 00:15-03:45 UTC in az-sea-2 to avoid partial-run artifacts.

maria_ops: added. also added a note in the playbook to pre-warm model KV caches using: 
```
curl -s https://internal-canary/generate -d '{"prompt":"warm"}'
```

tom_devex: will publish status update 1h before and at start, and ping CS leads.

elaine_sre: I'll own the monitoring dashboard and set alerts for p99 > baseline+20% and NIC err increase +0.3%.

maria_ops: thanks team. I'll post final checklist & post-mortem template in #eng-infra after completion. :thumbsup:
